title: Blood Resonance
next_chapter_hook: In the depths of that blood resonance spanning countless epochs, a familiar call pierced through the barrier of fate—"Brother Chen Ji, I sense you!" Chen Nian's voice exploded like thunder, yet whether it was hope or deeper despair remained unknown.

text.content:
The suspended chess piece trembled faintly in mid-air, as if fate itself held its breath, waiting for Chen Ji's choice. His right hand hovered in the air, the distance between his fingertips and that piece merely an inch, yet it felt like an abyss of ten thousand zhang.

At that moment, his chest suddenly burned with heat.

The fragment that had been quietly dormant on the first page of the Tianji Record was now burning on its own. Brilliant light burst forth from his heart—not scalding gold-red, but an ancient silver-white—the cosmic-level radiance that transcended the mortal realm and the comprehension of the cultivation world.

"This is..." Chen Ji's pupils constricted.

Silver-white light poured like the Milky Way, forming visible ripples around his body. Those ripples did not spread outward but contracted inward, like countless invisible threads drawing something forth from within him.

Chen Ji felt it.

It was a call from the deepest part of his bloodline, crossing the barriers of time and space, piercing through the divide between the mortal and immortal realms, resonating directly with his soul.

In that instant, he saw.

In the endless sea of stars, countless points of light arranged themselves like chess pieces on a board. And at the center of that board stood an ancient race—they called themselves the "Tianji Clan"—the product of cosmic-level experiments, tools used by ancient powerhouses to peer into heavenly secrets and weave fate.

The Chen family was precisely the遗珠 of this bloodline in the mortal realm.

A torrent of memories surged violently into Chen Ji's mind.

He saw the ancient era, when countless cultivators sacrificed themselves, fusing their souls with the laws of the Heavenly Dao, forging existences that transcended divine artifacts. And the Tianji Record was the most successful, yet most dangerous, masterpiece among them—it possessed self-awareness, could foretell the future, yet required a constant supply of "Heavenly Fate" to sustain its operation.

Where did those Heavenly Fates come from?

The answer chilled Chen Ji to his core: they came from the generations of the Tianji Clan's bloodline. Every person bearing Chen family blood was "fuel" for the Tianji Record. While they lived, they provided nourishment for this forbidden object; and when they died, all accumulated Heavenly Fate would instantly return to the Tianji Record, becoming the energy for its continued operation.

His mother, Chen Xuan, had known all of this years ago.

The silver-white light grew increasingly brilliant, and Chen Ji felt his bloodline boiling.

That sensation was indescribable—as if an ancient dragon dormant for countless epochs had awakened within him, breaking through all restraints with irresistible force. His cultivation advanced visibly: Foundation Building, Golden Core, Nascent Soul, Deity Transformation, Mahasiddha—each barrier was pierced through as easily as paper.

However, the cost was being generated simultaneously.

He could feel, in some remote corner of the mortal realm, a heart connected to him by blood was accelerating its beats. That heart belonged to his mother—Chen Xuan's flame of life was burning violently in a nearly self-destructive manner.

"Mother..." Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly.

"Child." A gentle yet weary voice rang in his mind, "Do not grieve. This is Mother's own choice."

dialogue.content:
Mother, is that you?

Chen Ji asked urgently in his heart. His consciousness was pulled into a silver-white space, and at the end of that space, a familiar figure gazed quietly at him.

It was a middle-aged woman whose elegance remained, bearing a seventy percent resemblance to Chen Ji in her features. Her face carried a hint of weariness, yet retained the tenderness and resilience Chen Ji remembered.

"Mother knows you've been searching for me." Chen Xuan smiled faintly, that smile carrying a touch of guilt, "And I know how hard these years have been for you. But child, some things must be discovered and chosen by yourself."

Why didn't you tell me?

Chen Ji's voice carried suppressed resentment and anger accumulated over years. He recalled the humiliations he suffered at the Tianqing Sect, those days of being trampled upon, every instance of longing for his mother when near death.

"If I'd known all this earlier, I wouldn't have had to..."

"Live so painfully?" Chen Xuan gently shook her head, interrupting him, "Child, do you think Mother didn't want to give you a stable life? But fate would not permit it. You were born bearing the Tianji Clan's destiny, and this was set the moment you came into the world."

Her gaze deepened: "More importantly, the Eye of Heavenly Dao has been watching you. If you lived too smoothly, too powerfully, it would notice you提前. And this 'trash' appearance of yours is precisely your best camouflage."

text.content:
Chen Ji fell silent.

He thought of the various experiences along his journey: those days of being mocked, those moments of "special attention" from Su Qingyao, those seemingly coincidental yet inevitable opportunities... So everything had been within his mother's expectations, or rather, within the Tianji Record's arrangement.

"You knew this day would come?"

"Mother only knew that sooner or later, you would face the choice of having to use 'Blood Resonance.'" Chen Xuan's voice carried a hint of relief, "And before that, all Mother could do was delay my own 'fuelization' as much as possible, leaving more Heavenly Fate for you to grow."

She reached out, gently stroking Chen Ji's cheek. Though the touch was merely illusory light, it caused Chen Ji's eyes to instantly moisten.

"Now, take your power." she said, "Mother has waited for this day for a very long time."

Blood Resonance reached its apex at this moment.

Chen Ji felt an unprecedented power surge from every limb and pore—that was mother Chen Xuan's lifetime accumulation of Heavenly Fate power, the essence of the Chen family's bloodline passed down across countless epochs. They surged madly within him, propelling him toward a realm humanity had never reached.

Heavenly Dao Level.

In that brief instant, Chen Ji felt the pulse of the Heavenly Dao. He could see the trajectories of stellar movements, hear the whispers from the depths of the universe, touch the barrier between past and future.

He could even see, on that distant battlefield, the first sign of wavering on Cang Yutian's arrogant face.

"This... this aura... how is this possible?!" Cang Yutian's voice carried panic for the first time.

At the same time, Chen Ji also felt the cost of that power.

He could clearly sense that in some corner of the mortal realm, mother Chen Xuan's flame of life was burning at ten times the normal speed. Her lifespan, her essence blood, everything about her was being converted into this brief Heavenly Dao Level power.

If no choice was made, she would completely dissipate within three years.

And if he interrupted Blood Resonance now, the power would immediately recede, but his mother's life could be preserved—at least for several more decades.

This was a multiple-choice question with no standard answer.

"Child." Chen Xuan's voice rang out again, gentle yet firm, "Don't consider Mother too much. You have your mission, people you care about, enemies you must defeat. Mother is old; the last thing I can do for you is send you further."

Her figure began to blur: "So, make your choice. Whatever it is, Mother won't blame you."

choice.prompt: Blood Resonance allowed Chen Ji to briefly touch Heavenly Dao Level power, but his mother's lifespan was depleting at an alarming rate. At this critical moment, Chen Ji must make a choice—burn through his mother's final life for absolute power at this moment, or interrupt the resonance to preserve her life?

choices.text: Burn Heavenly Fate, Slay the Mighty Enemy
choices.description: Accept Mother's will, push Blood Resonance to its limit, and with Heavenly Dao Level power, kill Cang Yutian with a single strike before he can react. The cost is Mother has only three years of life remaining.
choices.visible_cost: Mother Chen Xuan's lifespan depleted to zero, only three years to live
choices.visible_reward: Heavenly Dao Level power lasts for the duration of one incense stick, sufficient to crush Cang Yutian
choices.risk_hint: If no life-extending method is found within three years, Mother will be lost forever

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes.

"Mother, your child is unfilial."

He abruptly opened his eyes, silver light blazing in both pupils. At that moment, he was no longer a trash disciple, but the legitimate heir of the Tianji Clan, the world strategist with the Tianji Record in hand.

"Cang Yutian." His voice was cold as if from the depths of the Nine Netherworlds, "Are you prepared to die?"

choices.description: Forcefully cut off Blood Resonance, abandoning this rare opportunity. But Mother can continue living, with a chance to find a method to reverse Heavenly Fate.
choices.visible_cost: Losing the only chance to defeat Cang Yutian, must seek another way
choices.visible_reward: Mother's lifespan restored, can live at least another sixty years
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian will not give him a second chance

text.content:
Chen Ji's fingers suddenly withdrew.

Silver-white light receded like a tide, and that Heavenly Dao Level power capable of tearing the heavens instantly dissipated. His cultivation fell back to Mahasiddha Peak, and an insurmountable gap still existed between him and Cang Yutian.

But there was no regret in his heart.

"Mother, your child will find a way." he silently said in his heart, "There must be one."

choices.description: Guide only thirty percent of bloodline power, obtaining enough strength to battle Cang Yutian while preserving most of Mother's lifespan.
choices.visible_cost: Power insufficient for a decisive strike, may fall into a bitter battle
choices.visible_reward: Mother's lifespan only consumed by thirty percent, can live another forty years
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian's strength is terrifying, thirty percent power may not guarantee victory

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, attempting to find balance between power and familial affection.

The silver-white light remained brilliant, but compared to before, it had dimmed了几分. That Heavenly Dao Level oppressive aura vanished, replaced by a more restrained yet more dangerous presence.

"I don't need to crush you." Chen Ji gazed at Cang Yutian, the corner of his mouth lifting in a cold smile, "I only need... enough to kill you."

The afterglow of Blood Resonance had not yet fully dissipated when Chen Ji's consciousness remained immersed in that silver-white space. He gazed at his mother's gradually transparent form, and an indescribable bitterness welled in his heart.

"Child, don't be sad." Chen Xuan seemed to sense his emotions, smiling faintly, "Mother is already very satisfied, having watched you grow, become stronger, and reach this point."

She raised her hand, pointing at Chen Ji's chest: "The Tianji Record is not merely a prophetic tool. It records all the attempts, failures, and experiences of the Tianji Clan over ten thousand years. Among them is included... the method to reverse Heavenly Fate."

Chen Ji shuddered all over.

"The last page of the Ninth Volume." Chen Xuan's form had become nearly invisible, "That is Mother's final gift to you. Remember to search for it..."

Just as Chen Xuan's form was about to completely dissipate, a childish yet familiar voice suddenly pierced through the barrier of time and space.

"Brother Chen Ji!"

That voice exploded like thunder in Chen Ji's mind, causing him to shudder violently.

It was his missing sister of many years—Chen Nian!

"Brother Chen Ji, I sense you!" that voice carried irrepressible excitement and choked sobs, "Where are you? I can feel your bloodline pulsing... so warm, so familiar..."

Chen Ji's eyes instantly moistened.

How long had it been since he heard this voice? Ten years? Twenty? For cultivators, this was merely a fleeting moment in the long years; but for Chen Ji, it was countless nights of yearning and concern in his dreams.

"Niannian..." He下意识reached out his hand, but only grasped虚无.

However, just as Chen Ji was about to follow that voice, anomaly struck.

A beam of jet-black light abruptly tore through the silver-white space, like ink dropped into clear water, dyeing this pristine realm into turbidity. Within that darkness, a massive vertical pupil slowly opened, cold and majestic, overlooking Chen Ji's every move.

The Eye of Heavenly Dao!

"Interesting." A voice transcending language rang in Chen Ji's mind—it was not any concrete language, but a will directly branded into his soul, "The remnant of the Tianji Clan, not yet extinct?"

Chen Ji's entire body stiffened, feeling an unprecedented oppression. That was the gaze from the Heavenly Dao itself, a warning from fate to rebels.

"You think you can escape my chess game?" that voice carried a hint of mockery, "Child, you are too naive. From the moment you were born, you have been my chess piece."

Chen Ji's pupils constricted, but he quickly suppressed the fear in his heart.

He recalled what Mo Xiansheng once told him—"Never show weakness before an enemy." Even if that enemy was the lofty Heavenly Dao, even if its existence itself was a symbol of invincibility, he could not let it see his vulnerability.

"Chess piece?" Chen Ji slowly raised his head, the corner of his mouth lifting in a cold smile, "Heavenly Dao overestimates yourself."

His voice was terrifyingly calm: "You indeed arranged for ten thousand years, indeed used countless people as chess pieces. But you forgot one thing—"

He extended his right hand, five fingers spread open, brilliant silver light blazing in his palm.

"The dog that bites never barks."

The Eye of Heavenly Dao's vertical pupil slightly contracted. It seemed unprepared for a mere Mahasiddha-stage ant to dare behave so insolently before its true form.

"Interesting." that voice turned dangerous, "Then let me see, how deep can this ant bite."

The jet-black light abruptly contracted, receding like a tide. That massive vertical pupil cast one final glance at Chen Ji before vanishing, and the meaning contained within it made even his soul tremble.

It was not anger, but... anticipation.

Like a cat toying with prey about to enter its mouth.

The silver-white space restored tranquility, Chen Xuan's form had completely vanished. But at her position, a tiny point of light remained, floating slowly into Chen Ji's palm.

It was a crystal-clear tear—Chen Xuan's final tear.

"Child..." her voice emerged from that teardrop, weak yet tender, "Mother believes in you. No matter how tough the road ahead, persist..."

"And Niannian... find her... you are each other's only kin..."

The voice gradually faded, but that teardrop remained in Chen Ji's palm, warm as ever.

Chen Ji carefully tucked that teardrop into his chest, storing it close to his body.

His eyes slowly opened, the scene before him becoming clear once more. Cang Yutian still floated in mid-air, his face bearing that lofty arrogance; but in Chen Ji's eyes, that expression had become so ridiculous.

"You just..." Cang Yutian's brow furrowed slightly, seeming to sense something, "Who were you talking to?"

Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, the silver-white light around him fully收敛. His cultivation had returned to Mahasiddha Peak, but his aura was entirely different from before.

It was a transformation after experiencing life and death, bearing the weight of choices.

"Talking to whom?" Chen Ji smiled lightly, that smile carrying a hint of mockery, "Someone you are forever unworthy of meeting."

His right hand slowly raised, pointing at Cang Yutian: "Cang Yutian, I, Chen Ji,记住了今日之事. When I find Niannian and deal with the Tianji Record fragments, that will be your死期."

Cang Yutian's expression finally changed.

Not because of Chen Ji's threat, but because he sensed an familiar aura from Chen Ji—that was oppression from a higher plane, traces of Heavenly Dao Level power.

"You just... touched the Heavenly Dao Level?!" his voice carried disbelief, "Impossible! Absolutely impossible! You're merely a Mahasiddha-stage ant, how could you possibly..."

"Nothing is impossible." Chen Ji interrupted him, his voice calm yet carrying undeniable authority, "You think you understand this world? You think you stand at the peak of the cultivation realm?"

He shook his head, a hint of pity flickering in his eyes: "Cang Yutian, the gap between us is far greater than you imagine. Before the true chess game, you and I are all chess pieces—the only difference is, I know this, and you do not."

He turned away, not even glancing at Cang Yutian: "In three days, the Seventh Volume of the Tianji Record will open. Then, you will know what true power means."

In the depths of that blood resonance spanning countless epochs, a familiar call pierced through the barrier of fate—"Brother Chen Ji, I sense you!" Chen Nian's voice exploded like thunder, yet whether it was hope or deeper despair remained unknown.

Chen Ji's footsteps slightly faltered.

He could feel, in the direction from which that voice came, something calling to him. It was his sister, his obsession over many years, his only blood relative in this world.

"Niannian..." Chen Ji murmured softly, his fists unconsciously tightening.
